headline: Indian benchmark indices recover from early losses as Sensex crosses 81,000 and Nifty reclaims 25,000

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian equities staged a strong recovery from day's lows supported by oil price corrections and strong bank performance.
Sensex ended over 100 points higher after overcoming early trade profit-taking and IT sector selling.
Bulls maintained a firm grip on the market, helping Nifty reclaim the key 25,000 level.
Bargain hunting in US stock futures provided positive global cues despite Nvidia concerns.
whatHappening: Sensex surpassed 81,000 and Nifty settled above 25,000 after an initial early-morning dip.
Data Patterns share price surged 9% during the trading session.
BSE and NSE will remain shut tomorrow, November 10, for Diwali Balipratipada.
CPSEs achieved 60% of their FY27 capital expenditure target between April and October.
summary: Indian benchmark indices closed in the green on November 9 as Sensex crossed 81,000 and Nifty reclaimed 25,000. After opening in the green and dipping into the red due to IT selling and early profit-taking, markets staged a robust recovery powered by banking stocks and easing oil prices. Individual gainers included Data Patterns, which surged 9%, while Mphasis targeted double-digit growth for FY27.
